s1.desc: a room with a tiled pale slate wall and a small light switch

spans.notes: Pax waddles in from the right and reaches toward the light switch in an unlit room (camera locked: wall-edge fit identity 1.000). Dropped because the whole picture is under a dark grey-blue lights-off wash: Pax's white belly reads grey-blue and his feet brown, so his identity colours are off. Would be a clean keep without the wash
20 frames: Polly peeks out from behind a wooden door and steps out, under the same dim tint
10 frames: Pax at the light switch with Polly sliding in from the left edge
the overhead light comes on and washes the whole picture white
Polly flinches on a white background (flash-bang reaction), fading to pure white by f62; pure white f62-80
fade in from white to Polly at a TV cabinet (luma settles at f102)
8 frames: Polly switches on an orange table lamp, which blooms with a soft radial glow
plush toys of Pax and Polly sitting on a glass coffee table (lead copies); only Polly's flipper reaches in to switch on a lamp, and a radial glow builds around the plushies
wide living room: the Pax and Polly plushies sit on the coffee table in the foreground throughout; Polly switches on the floor and side lamps under heavy radial glow
the view widens to show an armchair on the right and Pax standing at the back
same living room, plushies still on the coffee table, glow overlays; Polly and Pax small at the back
14 frames: the living room after the overhead light is switched off, warm dim wash

Pax squints and rubs his eye in the dark, but the whole picture is under a heavy warm purple-brown colour wash with a yellow glow at the bottom: Pax reads purple with a salmon belly, so his identity colours are wrong
